messages:
alex: Heads-up: we started seeing a spike in client-side retry/queueing latency after the internal routing header change rolled out this morning. small sample but consistent across Python/TS SDK calls.

maya: :eyes: can you paste an example request and header set?

alex: sure — simplified:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer x...
X-RW-Route: latency-opt
X-RW-Sample: sampled=1;rate=0.1
User-Agent: Redwood-Python/0.35
```
latency goes up ~30-60ms on tail in our test harness when X-RW-Sample present.

kevin: is the server doing extra trace enrichment when X-RW-Sample is present? that header was meant to toggle sampling semantics only.

sam: deploy-bot: rollout 2025-06-26 08:12: deployed service/route-sampling v2 to prod (canary 10%).

deploy-bot: Notice: rollout started for route-sampling v2. Monitoring mirrors enabled.

maya: OK that explains timing. v2 switched from async sampling enrichment to synchronous KV lookup for deterministic sample decisions, to avoid double-sampling. That KV lookup is on hot path currently.

alex: right — SDKs now observe slightly higher p95 for small requests. It’s mostly the deterministic check doing a memcache-style lookup per-request.

kevin: ugh. We debated doing an async background sampler but opted for deterministic for consistency with console rollouts. We thought cost of lookup negligible.

liz: Can we short-circuit in the SDK when User-Agent matches certain SDK versions and add a header that tells the server "defer enrichment"? Feels hacky.

sam: we could add a header X-RW-Sample-Mode: best-effort which server treats as a hint to do async enrichment. But then rollout UX in console will show inconsistent sampling across routes.

maya: alternative: server-side cache the deterministic result per-route+client-token for 1s to eliminate repeated lookups for bursty calls. That would be infra change but lower tail latency.

alex: cache gRPC metadata/route keys? Could help. But this affects quota accounting/telemetry — need to be careful with console numbers.

kevin: telemetry concern: current dashboard shows "sampled traces" count. If we switch to best-effort async, the sampled count will dip intermittently and confuse users. We need a migration plan.

liz: Proposal: 1) revert deterministic lookup to cached lookup (1s TTL) in v2, 2) add SDK opt-in header X-RW-Sample-Hint: async for a phased canary, 3) add dashboard annotation for the rollout window so SRE/product know to ignore short-term deltas.

sam: timeline?

alex: I can patch runtime this afternoon to add caching layer for the lookup path (couple lines). If QA looks good, we can flip canary to 50% and monitor p95.

maya: SDK change for opt-in header should be non-breaking. But we should avoid shipping it in SDKs immediately — only internal clients can opt-in for canary.

kevin: we also need to add telemetry marker: add a new metric sample_enrichment_mode{mode="deterministic|cached|async"} so console can graph and filter. Otherwise retrospective debugging is painful.

liz: good call. Add console tile that shows mode percentages and correlate with p95. I'll file a quick ticket for dashboard annotation and tile.

alex: quick perf numbers from staging after patch: p95 dropped back to baseline; p99 still slightly elevated by ~10ms.

sam: we should update rollout notes in console to mention "sampling enrichment now cached; p99 may take longer to stabilize".

maya: one more: SDKs that implement client-side batching (python ts) may hide effect; others (go) see it more. We should add an SDK compatibility test to cross-sdk e2e harness for sampling header semantics.

kevin: agree — add a canary job in CI that hits all three client libs and asserts p95/p99 within thresholds.

liz: decision summary: alex to land caching change today, kevin to add metric + CI canary, liz to add console annotation/tile, maya to hold SDK header behind internal opt-in until canary is green. Rollout pause until p95/p99 stable.

alex: I'll post a short PR and tag eng-platform + eng-runtime.

kevin: thanks. Also let's document the header semantics in internal API docs: X-RW-Sample vs X-RW-Sample-Hint and modes. I'll draft the doc.

maya: If anyone sees new anomalies after patch, ping #incidents and @sre oncall.

liz: :thumbsup:

sam: deploy-bot: rollout paused at 10% pending caching patch.

deploy-bot: Notice: rollout paused.

alex: thanks all — keeping this thread for audit.

kevin: small follow-up: we should set a 90d deprecation plan if we later decide deterministic is unsupported for high-throughput routes.

maya: noted. we'll include that in the doc.

alex: end.
